summary: Iter82 data-cleanup verification (backend only). Confirmed '8" Bambooless Dhoop' (bambooless-dhoop-8inch) is fully purged from Mongo products, Mongo b2b_products, Supabase products_mirror, and the default seed; /api/products now returns exactly the 9 expected products and /api/products/bambooless-dhoop-8inch returns 404. bilvapatra-fragrance is renamed to 'Belpatra' in Mongo, in the B2C Supabase mirror row and in the public API (description no longer mentions 'Bilvapatra'). belpatra-dhoop-b2b SKU (product_id=bilvapatra-fragrance) intact with name 'Belpatra Dhoop' in Mongo + mirror. Iter79/80/81 regressions re-run: cascade delete + no-orphan + b2c price/stock hydration all pass. FOUND 1 rename miss: the auto-mirrored B2B SKU 'bilvapatra-fragrance-50g-b2b' still carries the OLD name 'Bilvapatra Fragrance' in both Mongo b2b_products and Supabase mirror. 15/19 assertions pass (1 skip), 3 fail (2 for the rename miss, 1 pre-existing mogra-magic mirror orphans).

critical.issue: Rename incomplete: auto-mirrored B2B SKU 'bilvapatra-fragrance-50g-b2b' (product_id='bilvapatra-fragrance') still has name='Bilvapatra Fragrance' in MongoDB b2b_products AND in Supabase products_mirror (channel='b2b'). This SKU's name is derived from the B2C product via services/product_sync.build_b2b_sku, so the migration must call services.product_sync.mirror_b2c_product(db, doc) (or update_many name on b2b_products where product_id='bilvapatra-fragrance' + re-mirror) after the rename. Retailers browsing the B2B catalog still see the old brand name.

minor.issue: Pre-existing orphans not related to iter82: 'mogra-magic-b2b' and 'mogra-magic-200-b2b' exist in products_mirror but have no MongoDB b2b_products parent (and no b2c 'mogra-magic' product). Leftover from an earlier product deletion whose b2b mirror rows were never cascaded. Both also have price_inr = NULL.

Could not exercise the authenticated catalog endpoint: documented B2B test retailer (test_b2b_retailer@example.com / Test@12345 in /app/memory/test_credentials.md) does not exist in db.retailers -> /api/retailer-auth/login returns 401. Unauthenticated call correctly returns 401. B2B SKU state was verified via Mongo + Supabase instead.

Public preview URL (NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://incense-rewards.preview.emergentagent.com) returns 404 for every /api path because next.config.js rewrites /api/:path* to that same public host (self-referencing proxy loop). Tests therefore ran against http://localhost:8001 like previous iterations.

action_items: Propagate the 'Belpatra' rename to linked B2B SKUs: update db.b2b_products name where product_id='bilvapatra-fragrance' (currently 'bilvapatra-fragrance-50g-b2b' = 'Bilvapatra Fragrance') and re-mirror to Supabase — easiest via services.product_sync.mirror_b2c_product(db, renamed_doc) inside the Iter82 migration; also make the migration idempotent-safe so it re-runs after this fix (current guard is name != 'Belpatra' on the b2c doc, which is now already satisfied so the block will be skipped -> use a separate guard for the b2b propagation).
Purge orphan mirror rows 'mogra-magic-b2b' and 'mogra-magic-200-b2b' from products_mirror (or restore their Mongo parents).
Seed/refresh the documented B2B test retailer (test_b2b_retailer@example.com / Test@12345) so the /b2b/catalog endpoint can be regression-tested end to end.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/products.py Iter82 block re-mirrors only the b2c row after rename; any derived b2b SKU generated by product_sync (name copied from the b2c product) drifts. Renames should always go through mirror_b2c_product to keep derived SKUs consistent.

The Iter82 delete/rename migration runs on every startup and swallows all exceptions with logger.warning — a permanent failure (e.g. Supabase down) would silently leave partial state; consider recording migration completion in a migrations collection.
seed_data_creation: No new data created. Cleaned up leftover TEST data from iteration 81 that was polluting the live storefront: products 'test-race-6a77afd2' and 'test-race-m-6f2842b2' (Mongo + 4 mirror rows) deleted via admin API + direct purge; also removed 2 stale 'mirror-regress-*' b2b mirror rows. /api/products now returns exactly 9 real products.
test_credentials: Admin contact.us@centraders.com / PIN 050499 (OTP read from mongo admin_2fa_tokens) works. B2B retailer test_b2b_retailer@example.com / Test@12345 does NOT exist in DB (401).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter82_product_cleanup.py -p no:randomly -v. Use BASE_URL=http://localhost:8001 (public preview /api is 404 due to self-referencing Next rewrite). Supabase verified with psycopg2 on SUPABASE_DB_URL (replace postgresql+asyncpg:// with postgresql://). Current known-failing tests: TestMongo::test_all_linked_b2b_skus_renamed and TestSupabaseMirror::test_no_stale_bilvapatra_name_in_mirror (bilvapatra-fragrance-50g-b2b old name), TestSupabaseMirror::test_no_orphan_b2b_mirror_rows (mogra-magic orphans). Mirror counts at time of test: b2c=9, b2b=18 (16 Mongo SKUs + 2 mogra-magic orphans). ALWAYS delete test products via /api/admin/products/{id} AND verify mirror rows are gone after ~5s, otherwise the storefront count breaks for the next iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: B2B SKUs are auto-derived from B2C products by services/product_sync.build_b2b_sku, which copies product['name'] verbatim. The Iter82 migration renamed only the B2C Mongo doc and re-mirrored the b2c Supabase row, so the derived SKU 'bilvapatra-fragrance-50g-b2b' (created by an earlier unified-products sync) retained 'Bilvapatra Fragrance'. Reproduce: db.b2b_products.find({'product_id':'bilvapatra-fragrance'}) -> belpatra-dhoop-b2b='Belpatra Dhoop' (hand-seeded, fine) and bilvapatra-fragrance-50g-b2b='Bilvapatra Fragrance' (stale). Fix: call mirror_b2c_product(db, doc) after the rename update, guarded independently of the b2c name check.
